precedents.why_it_matters: Raiatea↔Bora Bora is the cleanest premium-charter spoke — 20 nm of protected Society water that wires Raiatea-Tahaa directly into the built atlas node.

regulatory_note: French overseas collectivity regime — same DPAM oversight as Tahiti-Moorea. The Taputapuātea UNESCO marae adds a heritage / conservation layer with quiet-mode access expectations. Tainui Atea Marine Managed Area overlays the wider Society Islands waters.
seasonality: Year-round operability inside the lagoon; peak May–October (austral winter, drier, lower humidity). The Raiatea↔Bora Bora open hop sees occasional swell exposure but is workable through the shoulder season.
signature_routes: Raiatea (Uturoa) ↔ Bora Bora (Vaitape) premium spoke (Pioneer II)
summary: Raiatea and Tahaa share a single enclosed lagoon (~3 nm apart) and Raiatea (Apooiti Marina) is the bareboat-charter capital of French Polynesia — Moorings, Sunsail, Dream Yacht Charter and Tahiti Yacht Charter all base their FP fleets here. Bora Bora lies ~20 nm NW — comfortably in range for a premium-charter luxury lagoon loop. A strong luxury island-hopping archetype that connects directly into the built Bora Bora node; lower year-round commuter volume than Tahiti, but the highest charter density in FP.
tagline: French Polynesia's bareboat-charter capital — Raiatea + Tahaa share one enclosed lagoon, with Bora Bora 20 nm NW.
